**Astur v2.8.2** — floating windows open and move where you are looking, and
the Win+B taskbar shortcut fires reliably.

## Download

`astur-windows-x64.zip` holds `astur.exe` and `astur_settings.py`.

## What changed

- **A floating window opens centred in the workspace it belongs to.** A float
  whose rule names no monitor and no workspace now belongs to the focused
  screen instead of the screen its own initial rect happened to overlap, so it
  no longer appears on another monitor and pulls the focus there with it. It
  keeps its size, is shrunk only when larger than the work area, and is
  centred without being raised or activated.
- **A float sent to another workspace or monitor is centred there**, keeping
  its size: `Alt+Shift+,` `.` `/`, `Alt+Shift+L` `;` `'`, `Alt+1..0`, the
  move-mode keys and `Alt+Shift+Left/Right` all place it in the middle of the
  destination. Dragging a float still leaves it where it was dropped, and the
  scratchpad keeps its own spot.
- **Win+B waits a little longer** between its injected keystrokes, so the
  taskbar-edge press registers every time.

## Notes

- No config key was added or changed, no default changed, and existing config
  files are never rewritten.
